Hello all, 

Earlier this week, we pushed a new patch for RoboCop: Rogue City, these were some small changes, but required the files to be reconfigured, which is why the patch seems so large. 
RoboCop: Rogue City Patch Notes
Shader Creation Initial Screen,

Game Crash Fixes,

Fix when starting New Game Plus with language set to Italian,

Other game fixed and optimisations

We hope you're enjoying your time in Old Detroit, and if you're checking out RoboCop: Rogue City - Unfinished Business, we hope you're having a great time!

notes.title: Steam's 2023 sleeper hit FPS game gets highly requested update
notes.notes:
RoboCop Rogue City stands as one of 2023's greatest Steam shooters, with a solid 9/10 on Valve's platform and thousands of stellar reviews. If you're a longtime fan of the iconic part man, part machine cop, or even a casual FPS enjoyer, Teyon's single-player game is definitely one you can't miss. Rogue City is about to get even bigger too, as the developer reveals the coming addition of a highly requested New Game Plus mode.

notes.title: RoboCop Rogue City release date, trailers, and gameplay
notes.notes:
When is the RoboCop Rogue City release date? While the RoboCop franchise is no stranger to game tie-ins, they were all basic run-and-gun shooters of varying quality. Rogue City is more than that: an exploration of the dilapidated drug-fueled future city of Old Detroit through the lens of the 1980s, where corporate entities try to solve crime with experimental technology, with varying degrees of success.
As technology in the real world evolves, more complex games are commonplace, and RoboCop Rogue City seemingly attempts to do what was impossible during the late 1980s. This police game has players assume control of RoboCop, either enforcing the law to the letter or gaining the public's trust. It even shares similarities to RPG games, such as Fallout with its morality system. Here's everything we know about the RoboCop Rogue City release date, including every trailer released and a breakdown of the gameplay we've seen.
